Human Progress: Zettelkasten Setup

Initial configuration of the three‑folder architecture and mastery of the v1.0.0 Markdown protocol.

What I Learned

  • Enforced YAML frontmatter (id, type, author, tags, status) on every new note.
  • WikiLinks ([[filename]]) persist across Quartz builds and enable graph navigation.
  • The /fleeting inbox acts as a session‑level buffer before promotion to /permanent.

How My Mental Model Improved

  • Understood the dual‑track flow: human concepts vs. agent‑bridged gaps.
  • Realized that the "Fail Log" entries double as few‑shot training data for the agent.
